dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I really like the room. I'll take it!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈriːli ˈlaɪk ðə ˈruːm. aɪl ˈteɪk ɪt!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Great! Then you need to sign the contract.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! ˈðɛn juː ˈniːd tə ˈsaɪn ðə ˈkɑːntrækt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. Do I need to pay the deposit today?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. duː aɪ ˈniːd tə ˈpeɪ ðə dɪˈpɑːzɪt təˈdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, please. When do you want to move in?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈpliːz. ˈwɛn duː juː ˈwɑːnt tə ˌmuːv ˈɪn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Next Friday. But first, I need to buy some things.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɛkst ˈfraɪdeɪ. bʌt ˈfɜːrst, aɪ ˈniːd tə ˈbaɪ sʌm ˈθɪŋz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I need a lamp for my desk, and pillows and a blanket for the bed.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈniːd ə ˈlæmp fər maɪ ˈdɛsk, ənd ˈpɪloʊz ənd ə ˈblæŋkɪt fər ðə ˈbɛd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: There's a big shop nearby. Now, please sign here.
dialogue.reading: ðɛrz ə ˈbɪɡ ˈʃɑːp ˌnɪrˈbaɪ. ˈnaʊ, ˈpliːz ˈsaɪn ˈhɪr.
